content.comment_body: Will [article_no] eventually be compatible with [product_name] Web Editor?
No, there is no firmware update available for [product_name] [version_no], and a new [product_name] has been released since December 2017.
Thank you for your quick response!

analysis.insight_summary: Users asked about compatibility between older [product_name] hardware and the [product_name] Web Editor. They learned that no firmware updates are planned for previous hardware versions, and only new hardware releases (from [version_no] onward) will work with the Web Editor, leaving older hardware owners without upgrade options.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hoped their existing [product_name] hardware could be made compatible with the [product_name] Web Editor through a future firmware update.
